config._note: THE Property Opportunity Score weights (Jack's proposal, Oct 2026). Points out of 100. Read by scripts/scores/build_scores.py and backtest_scores.py; the build copies them into meta/scores/scores.json for the app (tour/lib/rc-scores.js). Change them here only, then rebuild.

roofAge._note: years since the last re-roof permit, else since the house was built. 0 points under fromYears, full at fullYears+. The age counts at the evidence confidence (meta/roof-evidence.json, PROGRESS-permits-v2.md): High 1.0, Medium 0.85, Low 0.7 (an ambiguous permit, or no re-roof since a complete permit list starts on an older house), Unknown 0.5 (year built only: at most the neutral middle, never the old-roof points)

storm._note: the best radar hail hit at the home in the last windowDays (not before a later re-roof permit): size (0.75 in = minFactor, 1 in = half, 2 in+ = full) x recency (full within freshDays, oldFactor at windowDays)

roof._note: roof size in squares (0 at fromSquares, full at fullSquares) x 0.75 + steep pitch (rise 6 to 10 in 12) x 0.25. Size is an estimate from the building outline or LiDAR

crm._note: added on the roofer's device at view time (the CRM is there, not in the data build): replied or asked for an inspection = full, talked at the door or opened the Proof Page = half, texted with no answer = a quarter. Opt-outs never add points; they block contact (eligibility), they do not change the score.

neighborhood._note: re-roof permits within radiusM in the last days (the Turnover Radar rule): 1 = 0.18, 2 to 3 = 0.55, 4+ = full

blocks._note: Neighborhood (block) score, 0 to 100: a block = one street's hundred-block in one city (1200 to 1299 Lassen Ln). NOT the raw number of homes. concentration = strong homes (score >= strong) as a count (full at fullStrong) and as a share of the block; storm = the block's average storm factor; route = strong homes per 100 m of street (homes per drive-minute, approximated by density; full at fullPer100m); engagement = replies / talks on the roofer's device, added at view time.

ev.2: year built, city with a complete permit list
ev.3: year built only (no complete permit list)
ev.16: flag: built after the city's permit list starts (original roof)
ev.32: flag: re-roofed in the last 5 years
ev.64: flag: the permit may be a repair (ambiguous)

sources.roof_size: building outline (county / Overture) or per-facet LiDAR 2018, an estimate
sources.hail: NOAA MRMS MESH radar hail per home (1 km grid), an estimate, not an inspection
